sections.title: What Is Water Line Repair?
sections.subtitle: Understanding main water supply pipe repairs
content: Water line repair involves inspecting, repairing or replacing damaged pipes that deliver water from the main supply line to a property.
Water lines can develop problems because of aging pipes, ground movement, corrosion or accidental damage.
Professional plumbers evaluate the condition of the water line before recommending the correct solution.
sections.highlight: Early water line inspection can help prevent extensive water damage and costly repairs.

faqs.question: What are signs of a damaged water line?
faqs.answer: Common signs include low water pressure, wet spots, unexpected water bills, discolored water and sounds of running water.

faqs.question: What is a main water line repair?
faqs.answer: Main water line repair involves fixing damaged pipes that supply water from the main connection to a property.

faqs.question: When does a water line need replacement?
faqs.answer: Water lines may require replacement when they have severe damage, repeated leaks, aging pipes or major performance issues.

faqs.question: Can underground water leaks be detected?

faqs.question: Is trenchless water line repair possible?
